actual_error: AssertionError in archive_git: set(changed) == set(selected) | {experiment record}
cause: git diff-tree --name-only quotes non-ASCII paths by default; the expected Python paths used literal Chinese. The scope check compared differently represented path strings.
resolution: Use NUL-delimited Git names. Preserve the original uncommitted draft, reset only the private clone index, and resume this same stage before commit. No existing trial/tag is replaced.
delivery: V1 ZIP retained; V2 adds this archival fix/evidence. Firmware, actor and ROS plugin implementations are unchanged from their passed checks.
